name: SMSTunnel Notifications for Ninja Forms
author: nicunarcisbodea

sections.description:
Get the SMSTunnel app on Google Play

SMSTunnel Notifications for Ninja Forms allows you to send SMS notifications when Ninja Forms are submitted. This plugin adds SMS actions to Ninja Forms.

The texts are sent from your own Android phone and number. You link the phone to your site by QR code in the main SMSTunnel plugin, and you can remove that connection anytime from the SMSTunnel app.

End-to-end encryption. Turn it on in the SMSTunnel plugin and these texts are encrypted for your phone before they leave WordPress, so only your phone can read the words. After your phone sends it, a text travels over the mobile network like any other SMS.

Features:

  • Send SMS notifications to administrators when forms are submitted
  • Send autoresponder SMS to form submitters
  • Support for multiple recipients
  • Full merge tag support for dynamic message content
  • Easy configuration through Ninja Forms actions

Requirements:

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Ninja Forms plugin
  • SMSTunnel plugin (for sending SMS)

This is a third-party integration built by SMSTunnel.io. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Ninja Forms or its trademark owner.

External Services

This plugin relies on the SMSTunnel service to deliver SMS notifications. When a notification is triggered, the recipient phone number and the message content are transmitted to the SMSTunnel API, which forwards them to your own paired Android device for delivery.

This service is provided by SMSTunnel.io (NARBOWEB SRL):

  • Service: SMSTunnel.io (NARBOWEB SRL)
  • Service URL: https://smstunnel.io
  • When data is sent: Only when a notification is triggered and you have enabled SMS notifications.
  • Data sent: The recipient phone number, the SMS message content, and any field values you include in the SMS template.
  • Privacy Policy: https://smstunnel.io/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://smstunnel.io/terms

This plugin is a third-party integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Ninja Forms. “Ninja Forms” is a trademark of its owner.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smstunnel-notifications-for-ninja-forms directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Ninja Forms and SMSTunnel plugins are installed and activated.
  4. Install the SMSTunnel app on your Android phone from Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.smstunnel.app) and link it in SMSTunnel > Quick Setup.
  5. Edit a form, open Emails & Actions, click the + button and pick SMSTunnel SMS (a text to you) or SMSTunnel SMS (2) Autoresponder (a text to the person who filled in the form).
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fixed: In debug mode WordPress no longer reports that Ninja Forms translations load too early. The SMS actions now set up their Ninja Forms settings on init.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: The SMS actions now appear in the form builder under Emails & Actions. Before, they were added after Ninja Forms had already built its list of actions.
  • Fixed: A new SMS action now has the Action Name and Active settings, and is switched on when you add it.
  • Fixed: No early translation notice in debug mode on WordPress 6.7 and later.

1.0.1

  • Security: Validate recipient phone numbers (E.164) and reject premium-rate numbers before sending, to prevent SMS abuse via public form fields

1.0.0

  • Initial release
